Solver.Description: Algorithm: 'newton', 'gradient', 'levenberg-marquardt', 'fsolve' (needs Optimization Toolbox) or 'dynamic' (virtual bus dynamics)

Tolerance.Description: [pu] Largest P/Q mismatch of a converged solution (every method)

MaxIteration.Description: Maximum number of iterations. NaN: automatic (newton 50, gradient 1e6, levenberg-marquardt 100, fsolve 400)

GradientStepSize.Description: Step size alpha of 'gradient'. NaN: automatic

WhenFailed.Description: Behavior if the power flow calculation does not converge

Verbose.Description: Print each iteration and the final message (the fsolve display for 'fsolve')

WarmStart.Description: Start from the last power flow solution of the network (false: flat start)

PlotFcn.Description: Live display during the analysis: 'residual' (a bar of |residual| per power equation, updated at each iteration) or 'none'. The figure after the analysis: result.Plot()
